summary: St James's Palace promises the press information about Prince William at least once a term, after admitting it had failed to provide enough access to him since October 2001.

Prince Charles's private secretary admitted St James's Palace failed to give the press sufficient access to Prince William over the past two years and promised to provide information about the young prince at least once a term.
The royal family bans the Sun newspaper from taking official pictures of Prince William after it published photographs of him on a Swiss ski holiday with a girlfriend.
The Mail on Sunday apologizes to Prince William after a protracted dispute over false allegations that he killed a deer, following a palace complaint to the Press Complaints Commission.
A Channel Five documentary, William's Women, about Prince William's love life is reviewed, using speculation and a lookalike rather than actual interviews with the prince.
A US intelligence report reveals that sections of the UK Ministry of Defence and many Britons would oppose Prince William joining the military, despite his stated interest in an armed forces career.

Prince William is discussed as a potential high-profile ambassador for London’s 2012 Olympic bid, with talks about him possibly attending the final IOC presentation in Singapore, but no decision has been made.

Prince William says in his first broadcast interview that he wants to follow his younger brother Harry into the army after graduating from the University of St Andrews next summer, but only if he is allowed to share the hardships of the troops under his command.

Clarence House announces that Prince William will undertake his first solo royal tour, accompanying the British and Irish Lions on their rugby tour of New Zealand in early July and representing the Queen at second world war commemorative events in Wellington and Auckland.
Prince William was awarded an upper second honours degree in geography from St Andrews University, making him the brainiest royal yet.
Prince William graduated from St Andrews University with a 2:1 in geography, becoming the first member of the royal family to receive a masters degree.
Prince William passed the four-day selection process to undergo officer cadet training at Sandhurst next year, Clarence House said.

Former News of the World royal editor Clive Goodman testified that he first hacked Kate Middleton's phone on this date, and also revealed he hacked Prince William's phone 35 times starting in January 2006.
Prince William begins 44 weeks of officer training at Sandhurst Royal Military Academy.
Prince Harry's waxwork was placed alongside Prince William's at Madame Tussauds.
Prince William is to join the Blues and Royals regiment as a troop leader after graduating from Sandhurst at the end of the year.
Prince William graduated from Sandhurst military academy and received his commission as an army officer.
Prince William and Kate Middleton are reported to be moving towards a formal engagement, though no engagement has been formally announced.
Prince William and Kate Middleton ended their relationship, with tabloids reporting the break-up and various unconfirmed theories about the split.
Prince William and Kate Middleton are confirmed to have split.

Prince Harry delivered an emotional eulogy at a memorial service marking the 10th anniversary of Princess Diana's death, describing her as a "guardian, friend and protector" to him and Prince William.
The Mail on Sunday editor criticizes photographers for hounding Prince William and Kate Middleton, stating that round-the-clock paparazzi pursuit is "not right."
Clarence House courtiers are discussing a plan for Prince William to undertake a brief work experience placement in the newsroom of a national newspaper, though no decisions had been taken.

Prince William was waiting with Prince Charles at RAF Brize Norton for Prince Harry's return from Afghanistan, and officials said William is likely to serve overseas with the Royal Navy later that year.

Prince William piloted an RAF Chinook helicopter from RAF Cranwell to Woolwich barracks and then to the Isle of Wight, described by the RAF as a legitimate training sortie, to attend his cousin Peter Phillips's pre-wedding celebrations.
Prince William made a secret visit to Kandahar airfield in Afghanistan to meet frontline troops before returning to the UK.
Prince William begins a two-month tour of duty with the Royal Navy aboard HMS Iron Duke, a frigate on hurricane relief duty and counter-narcotics patrols.
Prince William was involved in a drug raid when his ship, the Iron Duke, seized about 900 kg of cocaine in the Atlantic, north-east of Barbados.
Prince William is to undergo training with the RAF's Search and Rescue Force prior to an operational attachment of at least 30 months.
Prince William and his brother Prince Harry are to become joint patrons of the Henry Van Straubenzee Memorial Fund.
Prince William agreed to become patron of the Child Bereavement Charity and spoke about the emptiness he feels on Mother's Day.
Prince William is officially to open the revamped Whitechapel Art Gallery.
Prince William is to launch a charity with Prince Harry in a bid to be seen as more than just a royal "ornament".
Prince William expressed in a rare TV interview his desire to be more than an "ornament" who shakes hands and opens buildings.
Buckingham Palace rejects claims that Prince William was being installed as a "shadow king" ready to take on more of the Queen's official duties.
Royal officials insist Prince William's first official overseas tour to New Zealand, planned for January 2010, is not an attempt to head off growing republican feeling in the country.

Prince William is scheduled to represent the Queen at the opening of the new Supreme Court building in Wellington, New Zealand, on 17 January 2010, his first time representing the monarch in an official capacity.
Prince William begins his first official overseas tour, a five-day visit to New Zealand where he will stand in for his grandmother to open the new supreme court building in Wellington.
Prince William spent his last full day in Australia touring Victoria communities devastated by the 2009 bushfires, meeting survivors and residents.
Prince William proposes to Kate Middleton while on holiday in Kenya.
Snoop Dogg proposed his new single "Wet" as the anthem for Prince William's stag do and publicly offered it as a royal wedding gift, though he had not been formally approached.
Prince William missed the Remembrance Sunday ceremony at the Cenotaph in London because he was in Afghanistan with Defence Secretary Liam Fox to attend a service at Camp Bastion in Helmand province.
Prince William and Kate Middleton announce their engagement.
Prince William and Kate Middleton's engagement prompted widespread speculation about their wedding date and venue, with betting shops and retail analysts anticipating commercial benefits.
Prince William's impending royal wedding to Kate Middleton is noted for introducing a strong Yorkshire bloodline into the Royal Family.
Clarence House announces that the wedding of Prince William and Kate Middleton will take place on Friday 29 April at Westminster Abbey.
A Church of England bishop is suspended indefinitely after making disparaging remarks about Prince William and Kate Middleton's upcoming royal wedding.
The Royal Mint unveils an official commemorative £5 coin to mark Prince William's engagement, featuring an unflattering likeness of Kate Middleton.
Clarence House announces further details of the April 29 royal wedding between Prince William and Kate Middleton, including the route and service arrangements.
Prince William lobbied Prime Minister David Cameron over plans to cut the number of coastguard stations.
Prince William picks Prince Harry as best man at his royal wedding.
Clarence House announces that Prince William and Kate Middleton will visit Canada at the end of June for their first official overseas tour following their marriage.
Prince William and his fiancee Kate Middleton returned to the University of St Andrews, where they first met, to launch its 600th anniversary celebrations.
Kate Middleton was confirmed into the Church of England at a private service attended by Prince William.
Prince William and Kate Middleton ask people wishing to give them wedding presents to donate instead to a fund for 26 charities.
A see-through dress worn by Kate Middleton at a 2002 University of St Andrews charity fashion show attended by Prince William sold at auction for £65,000.
Prince William visited two towns in far north Queensland devastated by cyclone Yasi, including Cardwell and Tully, and attended an invitation-only dinner in Cairns.
Kate Middleton will not promise to "obey" Prince William in their royal wedding service, following Princess Diana's precedent.
Prince William is to marry Kate Middleton at Westminster Abbey, an event expected to be watched by hundreds of millions worldwide.
Prince William and Catherine, Duke and Duchess of Cambridge, arrived in Ottawa to begin their first official overseas trip together, an eight-day tour of Canada.

Prince William and his bride, the Duchess of Cambridge, attend Canada Day celebrations in Ottawa, where William is expected to give a speech and the couple will take part in events marking the 144th anniversary of Canada's foundation.

Following their 12-day visit to Canada and the US, the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge plan to go "under the radar" to focus on Prince William's RAF career and their married life, taking a break from royal duties for the rest of the summer.
Prince William is being deployed to the Falklands for six weeks in February and March to serve with the RAF search and rescue helicopter service.
Prince William co-piloted an RAF rescue helicopter that saved two crew members from a cargo ship that sank in the Irish Sea, with five others missing.
Argentina criticises Prince William's planned six-week RAF tour of duty in the Falkland Islands, calling it arrival "in the uniform of the conqueror."
Sean Penn criticizes Prince William's deployment to the Falklands as an act of provocation.
Sean Penn criticizes Britain for sending a message of "pre-emptive intimidation" to Argentina after the deployment of Prince William to the Falkland Islands.
Prince William completed a "routine" posting to the Falkland Islands, referenced amid the 30th anniversary of the conflict and a Guardian/ICM poll on whether Britain should protect the islands.
Prince William turns 30 and becomes entitled to inherit a substantial sum, estimated around £10m, from his mother Princess Diana's estate.
Prince William piloted a Sea King helicopter that rescued two teenage girls from a rip current off the coast of Anglesey.
Pregnant Kate leaves hospital with Prince William.
Prince William's future role in RAF search and rescue is left unclear after the service is contracted to be privatised from 2016.
A close friend of Prince William and Prince Harry, Harry Meade, files a civil claim against News Group Newspapers over alleged phone hacking by the News of the World.
The Times published a front-page story claiming, based on DNA analysis, that Prince William will be Britain's first king to have proven Indian ancestry, alongside a readers' offer with BritainsDNA.
Prince William stayed overnight at St Mary's Hospital with the Duchess of Cambridge and their newborn son, following the birth of the baby boy weighing 8lbs 6oz.
Prince William's wife, the Duchess of Cambridge, gave birth to a son, who is third in line to the throne.
Prince William and the Duchess of Cambridge presented their newborn son to the world at his first photocall outside St Mary's Hospital, saying they were still working on a name.
Prince William said he and Kate hope to bring baby Prince George to Australia next year.
Prince William gave his first interview since the birth of his son Prince George, discussing life as a new parent and releasing the first official photographs of George.
Prince William gave an interview for an ITV/CNN documentary expressing his hope that his son George will share his family's passion for wildlife conservation.
Prince William left operational duties in the armed forces after completing his tour as an RAF search and rescue helicopter pilot.
Prince William made his debut standing in for the Queen at Buckingham Palace, conducting his first investiture ceremony and bestowing knighthoods and other honours.
A former Sandhurst pharmacy assistant is given a nine-month suspended sentence for selling stories about Prince William and Prince Harry to a tabloid newspaper.

The News of the World hacked voicemail messages from Prince William to Kate Middleton, including one in which he said he "nearly got shot" by blank rounds during an army training exercise, a court is told.
Prince William has been granted a place on a bespoke sustainability course devised by the Cambridge Programme for Sustainability Leadership.
Prince William and Prince Harry discreetly joined flood relief efforts in Datchet, Berkshire, helping soldiers from the Household Cavalry load sandbags before being spotted by the Guardian.
Prince William, Catherine, and Prince George arrive in New Zealand for a 10-day royal tour.
The Duke and Duchess of Cambridge, with Prince George, departed Australia from Canberra, concluding their royal tour.

A jury at the Old Bailey hears that former News of the World royal editor Clive Goodman hacked Kate Middleton's phone 155 times while she was dating Prince William, with Goodman's lawyer calling the hacking a shameful act.

Prince William visited Coventry and launched the centenary fields project as president of the Fields In Trust charity, aimed at protecting war memorial fields, parks, and green spaces created in memory of those who lost their lives during the First World War.
Prince William planned to join the East Anglian air ambulance as a pilot next spring, deferring full-time royal engagements.
Prince William's wife, the Duchess of Cambridge, was admitted to St Mary's Hospital in London in the early stages of labour for the birth of their second child.
Official photographs from Princess Charlotte's christening, including images of Prince William with his family, were taken by Mario Testino and later released by Kensington Palace.
Prince William's office publishes a letter warning the paparazzi against pursuing Prince George, describing intrusive tactics used to photograph the family.

Prince William gave a speech to British diplomats at the Foreign Office in London, stating that Britain's ability to work with other nations is the "bedrock of our security and prosperity," which prompted speculation that he was endorsing continued EU membership, though Kensington Palace said the speech was not about Europe.
The Sun published a critical article accusing Prince William of being a reluctant royal who shuns public engagements, following his first public appearance of 2016.
Prince William and Kate joined Indian celebrities at a charity gala in Mumbai, wrapping up the first day of their tour of India and Bhutan.

Prince William becomes the first member of the royal family to be photographed for the cover of a gay magazine, appearing in the July issue of Attitude magazine to discuss mental health and homophobic bullying.

Newly released Downing Street files reveal that Thatcher press secretary Bernard Ingham recommended releasing official footage of Prince William in 1983 to divert news coverage from CND anti-nuclear protests.
Prince William and Catherine, Duke and Duchess of Cambridge, began their first official visit to Paris, meeting French president François Hollande at the Élysée Palace.
Prince William speaks about his shock at being called out to his first suicide as an air ambulance pilot in a joint interview with Prince Harry on tackling masculinity and mental health issues.
A theory suggested that June 3 and 4 were blocked out on palace diaries, leading to speculation that Prince William and Kate Middleton would announce a royal engagement.

A US gossip magazine published a story claiming Prince William is not his parents' firstborn child, alleging an elder sister named "Sarah" was born from in vitro fertilization during Princess Diana's pre-wedding check-up.
Prince William leaves the armed forces to focus on charity.
Sean Penn criticized Prince William's posting in the Falklands.
Prince William commented on the second royal baby, saying "it's been a tricky few days."
